name: Salesforce
description: The Sumo Logic App for Salesforce analyzes logs generated by Salesforce Event Monitoring, which provides insight into your Salesforce instance and apps. The App allows you to monitor APEX and API performance, logins, report performance, setup audit activity, user activity, and user agents.

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"Login\"" 
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "CLIENT_IP", "USER_ID"
| where event_type="Login"
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://location on ip=client_ip
| where !isNull(latitude)
| backshift _messagetime as t2 | backshift latitude as lat2 | backshift longitude as lon2
| where !isNull(t2) and !isNull(lat2) and !isNull(lon2)
| (t2 - _messagetime)/1000 as time_delta
| lat2 - latitude as dlat | lon2 - longitude as dlon
| (sin(dlat/2))*(sin(dlat/2)) + cos(latitude) * cos(lat2) * (sin(dlon/2)) * (sin(dlon/2)) as a
| 2 * atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1-a)) as c
| 3961 * c as distance
| formatDate(_messagetime, "MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss.SSS") as t1 
| formatDate(toLong(t2), "MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss.SSS") as t2 
| first(t1) as time1, first(t2) as time2, first(time_delta) as time_delta, first(client_ip) as client_ip, first(distance) as distance by user_id

panels.name: APEX Average Run Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "RUN_TIME" Apex*
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "RUN_TIME" 
| where event_type matches "Apex*" 
| timeslice 1h 
| avg(run_time) as avg_run_time by _timeslice

panels.name: API Actions by User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" *API*
| json "EVENT_TYPE" nodrop
| where (event_type matches "*API*") or (event_type matches "*Api*")
| json "USER_ID" nodrop
| json "CLIENT_IP" nodrop
| json "CLIENT_ID" nodrop
| json "CLIENT_NAME" nodrop
| json "ENTITY_TYPE" nodrop
| json "METHOD" nodrop
| json "OPERATION" nodrop
| json "OPERATION_TYPE" nodrop
| json "METHOD_NAME" nodrop
| json "USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" nodrop
| json "URI", "REQUEST_STATUS", "API_VERSION" nodrop
| if (!isNull(client_id), client_id, client_name) as client_name
| if (!isNull(client_name), client_name, entity_type) as client_name
| if (!isNull(method), method, operation) as action
| if (!isNull(operation_type), operation_type, action) as action
| if (!isNull(method_name), method_name, action) as action
| fields -(entity_type, client_id, operation_type, operation, method_name) 
| format("%s - %s", event_type, action) as action_combo
| format("%s : %s",user_id_derived_lookup, user_id) as user_id
| count by user_id, action_combo
| transpose row user_id column action_combo

panels.name: Slowest Classes in APEX SOAP Calls
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" Apex* "CLASS_NAME" "RUN_TIME"
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "CLASS_NAME", "RUN_TIME" 
| where event_type matches "Apex*" 
| avg(run_time) as avg_run_time by class_name 
| sort by avg_run_time desc

panels.name: SOQL Run Time by URI
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" Apex*
| json "EVENT_TYPE"
| json "URI", "RUN_TIME" nodrop 
| json "Query" nodrop
| where event_type matches "Apex*" 
| count, avg(run_time) as avg_run_time by query, uri

panels.name: Slowest Pages in APEX Calls
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" Apex* "RUN_TIME" "URI"
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "URI", "RUN_TIME" 
| where event_type matches "Apex*" 
| avg(run_time) as avg_run_time by uri 
| sort by avg_run_time desc

panels.name: Non-REST API Actions by Client
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" *API* !RESTAPI 
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "CLIENT_ID", "CLIENT_NAME", "ENTITY_TYPE", "OPERATION_TYPE", "OPERATION", "METHOD_NAME", "API_VERSION" nodrop
| json "USER_ID", "URI", "REQUEST_STATUS" nodrop 
| where (event_type matches "*API*") or (event_type matches "*Api*")
| if (!isNull(client_id), client_id, client_name) as client_name
| if (!isNull(client_name), client_name, entity_type) as client_name
| if (!isNull(operation_type), operation_type, operation) as action
| if (!isNull(method_name), method_name, action) as action
| fields -(entity_type,client_id, operation_type, operation, method_name) 
| count by client_name, action, api_version
| transpose row api_version, client_name column action

panels.name: REST API Calls over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" RESTAPI "REQUEST_STATUS"
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "CLIENT_IP", "URI", "REQUEST_STATUS" 
| json "CLIENT_IP", "URI"
| where EVENT_TYPE="RestApi"
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, request_status
| transpose row _timeslice column request_status

panels.name: Load by API Type
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" *API* 
| json "EVENT_TYPE"
| where (event_type matches "*API*") or (event_type matches "*Api*")
| count by event_type 
| sort by _count

panels.name: Logins by Location
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "CLIENT_IP" LOGIN*
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "CLIENT_IP"  
| where (event_type matches "Login*") 
| count by client_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://location on ip=client_ip  
| sort by _count desc

panels.name: Logins by Status over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce  "EVENT_TYPE" "Login" "REQUEST_STATUS"
| json "EVENT_TYPE"
| json "REQUEST_STATUS"
| where event_type = "Login" 
| timeslice 1h 
| if (request_status="","S",request_status) as request_status
| if (request_status = "F", "failure", request_status) as request_status
| if (request_status = "S", "success", request_status) as request_status
| if (request_status = "U", "uninitialized", request_status) as request_status 
| if (request_status = "A", "authorization error", request_status) as request_status 
| if (request_status = "R", "redirect", request_status) as request_status 
| if (request_status = "N", "not found", request_status) as request_status 
| count by request_status, _timeslice | transpose row _timeslice column request_status

panels.name: LoginAs by Source User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce  "EVENT_TYPE" "LoginAs"
| json "CLIENT_IP", "EVENT_TYPE", "USER_ID", "DELEGATED_USER_NAME", "URI","USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as src_ip, event_type, dest_user_id, src_user,uri,dest_user nodrop 
| where event_type = "LoginAs" 
| count by src_user, dest_user,dest_user_id 
| format("%s : %s",dest_user, dest_user_id) as dest_user_id 
| fields -dest_user 
| sort by _count 
| transpose row src_user column dest_user_id

panels.name: Logins by External Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce  "EVENT_TYPE" "Login" "REQUEST_STATUS" "USER_NAME"
| json "EVENT_TYPE"
| json "REQUEST_STATUS"
| json "USER_NAME"
| where (event_type = "Login") and !(user_name matches "*@sumologic.com") and  (user_name!="") 
| toLowerCase(user_name) as user_name | user_name as src_user
| if (request_status="","S",request_status) as request_status
| if (request_status = "F", "failure", request_status) as request_status
| if (request_status = "S", "success", request_status) as request_status
| if (request_status = "U", "uninitialized", request_status) as request_status 
| if (request_status = "A", "authorization error", request_status) as request_status 
| if (request_status = "R", "redirect", request_status) as request_status 
| if (request_status = "N", "not found", request_status) as request_status 
| count by src_user,request_status 
| transpose row  src_user column request_status

panels.name: Login Attempt Outlier
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "Login"
| json "EVENT_TYPE"
| where event_type = "Login" 
| timeslice 1h 
| count by _timeslice 
| outlier _count

panels.name: Failed Logins by Client IP
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" Login "REQUEST_STATUS" "CLIENT_IP"
| json "EVENT_TYPE" 
| json "REQUEST_STATUS"
| json "CLIENT_IP" as src_ip
| where event_type = "Login" and request_status != "Success"
| count by src_ip 
| sort by _count desc

panels.name: Most Active Client IPs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "CLIENT_IP" login 
| json "CLIENT_IP" as src_ip
| count by src_ip 
| where src_ip<>""
| sort by _count desc

| json "USER_NAME" as src_user
| where src_user not in ("marketo@sumologic.com", "api@sumologic.com", "") 
| count by src_user | sort by _count desc

panels.name: Most Active Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"USER_NAME\""
| json "USER_NAME" as src_user
| where src_user not in ("marketo@sumologic.com", "api@sumologic.com", "") 
| count by src_user | sort by _count desc

panels.name: Logins by Location
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "CLIENT_IP" LOGIN*
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "CLIENT_IP"  
| where (event_type matches "Login*") and client_ip<>""
| count by client_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://location on ip=client_ip 
| where !isNull(latitude)
| sort by _count desc

panels.name: Top 10 Active Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"USER_NAME\""
| json "USER_NAME" 
| where user_name not in ("marketo@sumologic.com", "api@sumologic.com", "") 
| count by user_name
| top 10 user_name by _count

panels.name: Most Viewed Reports
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "REPORT_ID" "REPORT_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" "Report"
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "REPORT_ID", "REPORT_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP"  
| where (event_type = "Report") and (report_id!="")
| format("%s : %s",report_id_derived_lookup, report_id) as report_id
| count by report_id
| sort by _count desc 
| top 20 report_id by _count

panels.name: Most Downloaded Documents
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "FILE_NAME" "FILE_TYPE" "DocumentAttachmentDownloads" 
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "ENTITY_ID", "FILE_NAME", "FILE_TYPE" , "USER_ID_DERIVED"
| where (event_type="DocumentAttachmentDownloads") and !(file_name matches "Marketo *") and !(file_name matches "Zendesk *") 
| where !(FILE_TYPE matches "image*")
| count as Count by FILE_NAME
| sort by count

panels.name: REST API Calls by URI
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"RestApi\"" "URI" 
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "URI"
| where EVENT_TYPE="RestApi"
| count by URI
| sort by _count

panels.name: Report Run Count and Average Run Time (ms)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "RUN_TIME" Report 
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "RUN_TIME" 
| where event_type = "Report" 
| timeslice 1h
| count, avg(run_time) as avg_run_time by _timeslice

panels.name: Top 10 Slowest Reports
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "REPORT_ID_DERIVED" "RUN_TIME" Report
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "REPORT_ID_DERIVED", "RUN_TIME", "REPORT_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as event_type, report_id, run_time, report_id_lookup
| where (event_type = "Report") and (report_id != "")
| format("%s : %s",report_id_lookup, report_id) as report_id
| avg(run_time) as avg_run_time by report_id 
| sort by avg_run_time desc 
| top 10 report_id by avg_run_time

panels.name: Most Viewed Reports
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "REPORT_ID_DERIVED" Report
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "REPORT_ID_DERIVED", "REPORT_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as event_type, report_id, report_name
| where (event_type = "Report" and report_id != "")
| format("%s : %s",report_name, report_id) as report_id
| count by report_id 
| top 20 report_id by _count

panels.name: Most Active Report Viewers
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "Report" "USER_ID_DERIVED" "USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP"
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "USER_ID_DERIVED", "USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as event_type, user_id, username 
| where event_type = "Report" 
| format("%s : %s",username, user_id) as user_id
| count by user_id | sort by _count desc

panels.name: Setup Audit Activity by Section
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce attributes "\"type\":\"SetupAuditTrail\"" Section
| json "attributes.type", "CreatedById", "CreatedById_LOOKUP", "Display", "Action", "Section" as type, src_user_id, src_user, display, action, section  
| where type="SetupAuditTrail" 
| fields -_raw
| count by section 
| sort by _count

panels.name: Recent Security Control Activities
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce attributes "\"type\":\"SetupAuditTrail\"" "\"Section\":\"Security Controls\""
| json "attributes.type", "CreatedById", "CreatedById_LOOKUP", "Display", "Action", "Section", "CreatedDate" as type, src_user_id, src_user, display, action, section, time
| where type="SetupAuditTrail" and Section="Security Controls"
| count by src_user, src_user_id, display, action, _messagetime, time
| format("%s : %s", src_user, src_user_id) as src_user 
| sort by -_messagetime  
| fields -_count, _messagetime, src_user_id

panels.name: Recent Data Management Activities
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce attributes "\"type\":\"SetupAuditTrail\"" "\"Section\":\"Data Management\""
| json "attributes.type", "CreatedById", "CreatedById_LOOKUP", "Display", "Action", "Section", "CreatedDate" as type,src_user_id, src_user, display, action, section, time
| where type="SetupAuditTrail" and Section="Data Management"
| format("%s : %s",src_user, src_user_id) as src_user
| count by src_user, display, action, _messagetime, time  
| sort by -_messagetime  
| fields -_count, _messagetime

panels.name: Setup Audit Activity by User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce attributes "\"type\":\"SetupAuditTrail\""
| json "attributes.type", "CreatedById", "CreatedById_LOOKUP", "Display", "Action", "Section" as type, src_user_id, src_user, display, action, section  
| where type="SetupAuditTrail" 
| format("%s : %s", src_user, src_user_id) as src_user
| count by src_user, display, action, section, _messagetime 
| count by src_user, display
| transpose row src_user column display

panels.name: Recent User Management Activities
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce attributes "\"type\":\"SetupAuditTrail\"" "\"Section\":\"Manage Users\"" 
| json "attributes.type", "CreatedById", "CreatedById_LOOKUP", "Display", "Action", "Section", "CreatedDate" as type, src_user_id, src_user, display, action, section, time
| where type="SetupAuditTrail" and Section="Manage Users"
| format("%s : %s", src_user, src_user_id) as src_user
| count by src_user, display, action, _messagetime, time
| sort by -_messagetime  
| fields -_count, _messagetime

panels.name: Most Accessed Dashboards
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"Dashboard\"" "DASHBOARD_ID_DERIVED" "DASHBOARD_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP"
| json "EVENT_TYPE"
| json "DASHBOARD_ID_DERIVED", "DASHBOARD_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as dashboard_id, dashboard_name 
| where event_type = "Dashboard"
| count by dashboard_id, dashboard_name
| format("%s : %s", dashboard_name, dashboard_id) as dashboard_id
| count by dashboard_id
| sort by _count desc | top 20 dashboard_id by _count

panels.name: Non-Login Activities
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "client_ip" 
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "CLIENT_IP" 
| json "USER_ID_DERIVED" as user_id nodrop | json "DELEGATED_USER_ID_DERIVED" as user_id nodrop 
| json "USER_ID_DERIVED" as username nodrop | json "DELEGATED_USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as username nodrop
| where !(event_type matches "Login*") and client_ip!=""
| count by client_ip,username,user_id
| format("%s : %s",username, user_id) as user_id
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://location on ip=client_ip 
| count by latitude, longitude | sort by _count desc

panels.name: Content Document Sharing
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"ContentDocumentLink\"" sharing document
| json "EVENT_TYPE"
| where event_type matches "ContentDocumentLink"
| json "DOCUMENT_ID", "SHARING_PERMISSION", "SHARING_OPERATION" nodrop 
| json "USER_ID_DERIVED", "SHARED_WITH_ENTITY_ID" as src_user_id, dest_user nodrop
| json "DOCUMENT_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as document_name nodrop
| json "USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as src_user nodrop
| if (sharing_permission matches "V", "View", sharing_permission) as sharing_permission
| if (sharing_permission matches "I", "Inferred", sharing_permission) as sharing_permission
| if (sharing_permission matches "C", "Collaborator", sharing_permission) as sharing_permission
| format("%s : %s", sharing_operation, sharing_permission) as action
| format("%s : %s", document_name, document_id) as document_id
| format("%s : %s", src_user, src_user_id) as src_user
| count by src_user, action, dest_user, document_id

panels.name: Most Accessed Reports
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"Report\""
| json "EVENT_TYPE"
| json "REPORT_ID_DERIVED", "REPORT_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as report_id, report_name
| where event_type = "Report"
| count by report_name, report_id
| format("%s : %s", report_name, report_id) as report_id
| count by report_id 
| top 20 report_id by _count

panels.name: Most Exported Reports
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"ReportExport\""
| json "EVENT_TYPE"
| json "REPORT_DESCRIPTION", "USER_ID_DERIVED", "USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as report_description, user_id, username
| where (event_type = "ReportExport") 
| parse field=REPORT_DESCRIPTION "cust_name=*&" as reportName
| count by reportName, username, user_id
| replace(reportName,"+"," ") as reportName
| format("%s : %s", username, user_id) as user_id
| count by reportName, user_id | sort by _count
| transpose row reportName column user_id

panels.name: Most Document Attachment Downloads
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"DocumentAttachmentDownloads\""
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "ENTITY_ID", "FILE_NAME", "FILE_TYPE" 
| json "USER_ID_DERIVED", "USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as user_id, username
| where (event_type="DocumentAttachmentDownloads") and !(file_name matches "Marketo *") and !(file_name matches "Zendesk *") 
| count by file_type, file_name 
| sort by _count

panels.name: Most Accessed Documents
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"ContentTransfer\""
| json "EVENT_TYPE"
| json "DOCUMENT_ID_DERIVED", "DOCUMENT_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP", "FILE_TYPE" as document_id, document_name, file_type
| where event_type="ContentTransfer"
| count by document_id, document_name
| format("%s : %s", document_name, document_id) as document_id
| sort by _count desc | top 20 document_id by _count

panels.name: Activities by User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "USER_ID_DERIVED" 
| json "EVENT_TYPE"
| json "USER_ID_DERIVED", "USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as src_user_id, src_user
| count by src_user, src_user_id, event_type
| format("%s : %s", src_user, src_user_id) as user_id
| count by user_id, event_type
| sort by _count
| transpose row user_id column event_type

panels.name: Most Content Transferred Documents
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"ContentTransfer\""
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "USER_ID_DERIVED", "USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP", "TRANSACTION_TYPE", "FILE_TYPE", "FILE_PREVIEW_TYPE", "DOCUMENT_ID_DERIVED", "DOCUMENT_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as event_type, src_user_id, src_user, transaction_type, file_type, file_preview_type, document_id, document_name
| where event_type="ContentTransfer"
| count by document_id, document_name, src_user, src_user_id 
| format("%s : %s", document_name, document_id) as document_id
| format("%s : %s", src_user, src_user_id) as user_id
| count by document_id,user_id 
| transpose row document_id column user_id

panels.name: Last Logins by User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"Login\""
| json "USER_NAME" nodrop
| json "USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" nodrop
| json "API_TYPE" nodrop
| if (user_name="", user_id_derived_lookup, user_name) as src_user
| where api_type=""
| max(_messagetime) as LastLogin by src_user
| sort by +lastLogin, -src_user 
| limit 50
| formatDate(toLong(LastLogin), "YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") as LastLogin
| fields src_user, LastLogin

panels.name: Reports Exported by User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"ReportExport\""
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "REPORT_DESCRIPTION", "USER_ID_DERIVED","USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as event_type, report_description, src_user_id, src_user
| where (event_type = "ReportExport") 
| parse field=REPORT_DESCRIPTION "cust_name=*&" as reportName
| count by src_user, src_user_id, reportName
| replace(reportName,"+"," ") as reportName
| format("%s : %s", src_user, src_user_id) as src_user
| sort by _count

panels.name: Data,  Users, Security Changes by Admin
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce  attributes "\"type\":\"SetupAuditTrail\""  ("\"Section\":\"Manage Users\"" OR "\"Section\":\"Data Management\"" OR "\"Section\":\"Security Controls\"")
| json "attributes.type", "CreatedById","CreatedById_LOOKUP", "Display", "Action", "Section", "CreatedDate" as type, src_user_id, src_user, display, action, section, time
| where type="SetupAuditTrail" 
| count by Section, Action , Display, src_user, src_user_id
| format("%s : %s", src_user, src_user_id) as src_user
| count by src_user, Section, Action, Display
| sort by src_user asc

panels.name: User Document Downloads
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "\"EVENT_TYPE\":\"DocumentAttachmentDownloads\"" "FILE_NAME" "FILE_TYPE"
| json "EVENT_TYPE", "ENTITY_ID", "FILE_NAME", "FILE_TYPE" , "USER_ID_DERIVED", "USER_ID_DERIVED_LOOKUP" as event_type, entity_id, file_name, file_type, src_user_id, src_user
| where (event_type="DocumentAttachmentDownloads") and !(file_name matches "Marketo *") and !(file_name matches "Zendesk *") 
| where !(FILE_TYPE matches "image*")
| count by src_user, src_user_id, FILE_NAME
| format ("%s : %s", src_user, src_user_id) as src_user
| sort by src_user asc
| fields src_user, FILE_NAME

panels.name: Created Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce  attributes "\"type\":\"SetupAuditTrail\"" "\"Section\":\"Manage Users\"" "\"Action\":\"createduser\""
| json "attributes.type", "CreatedById","CreatedById_LOOKUP", "Display", "Action", "Section", "CreatedDate" as type, src_user_id, src_user, display, action, section, time
| where type="SetupAuditTrail" and Section="Manage Users" and Action="createduser"
| count by src_user, src_user_id, display
| format ("%s: %s", src_user, src_user_id) as src_user
| sort by src_user asc, display asc
| fields -_count, src_user_id

panels.name: Password Changes
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce attributes "\"type\":\"SetupAuditTrail\"" "\"Section\":\"Manage Users\"" *password*
| json "attributes.type", "CreatedById", "CreatedById_LOOKUP", "Display", "Action", "Section", "CreatedDate" as type, src_user_id, src_user, display, action, section, time
| where type="SetupAuditTrail" and Section="Manage Users" and action matches "*password*"
| count by Display, src_user, src_user_id
| format ("%s: %s", src_user, src_user_id) as src_user
| sort by Display asc
| fields Display, src_user

panels.name: Deactivated Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce  attributes "\"type\":\"SetupAuditTrail\"" "\"Section\":\"Manage Users\"" "\"Action\":\"deactivateduser\""
| json "attributes.type", "CreatedById", "CreatedById_LOOKUP", "Display", "Action", "Section", "CreatedDate" as type, src_user_id, src_user, display, action, section, time
| where type="SetupAuditTrail" and Section="Manage Users" and Action="deactivateduser"
| count by display, src_user, src_user_id
| format ("%s: %s", src_user, src_user_id) as src_user
| sort by src_user asc, display asc
| fields -_count, src_user_id

panels.name: Platform Distribution
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "BROWSER_TYPE" | json "BROWSER_TYPE"
| if (browser_type matches "*Windows *" OR browser_type matches "*Win32*" OR browser_type matches "*Win64*","Windows","") as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*Macintosh*" OR browser_type matches "*Darwin/*" OR browser_type matches "*Mac OS*","MacOS",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "* CrOS *","Chrome OS",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*Linux*","Linux",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*iPad*","iPad",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*iPhone*","iPhone",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*Android*","Android",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*Windows Phone*","Windows Phone",OS) as OS
| if (OS == "","Other",OS) as OS
| count by os | sort by _count desc

panels.name: Browser Distribution
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Salesforce "EVENT_TYPE" "BROWSER_TYPE" | json "BROWSER_TYPE"
| if (browser_type matches "*Windows *" OR browser_type matches "*Win32*" OR browser_type matches "*Win64*","Windows","") as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*Macintosh*" OR browser_type matches "*Darwin/*" OR browser_type matches "*Mac OS*","MacOS",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "* CrOS *","Chrome OS",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*Linux*","Linux",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*iPad*","iPad",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*iPhone*","iPhone",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*Android*","Android",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "*Windows Phone*","Windows Phone",OS) as OS
| if (OS == "","Other",OS) as OS
| if (browser_type matches "Mozilla/*; rv:*)*","Mozilla","") as Browser
| if (browser_type matches "*MSIE*","Internet Explorer",Browser) as Browser
| if (browser_type matches "*Firefox*","Firefox",Browser) as Browser
| if (browser_type matches "*Safari*","Safari",Browser) as Browser
| if (OS=="Android" AND browser_type matches "*WebKit*","WebKit",Browser) as Browser
| if ((OS=="iPhone" OR OS=="iPad") AND (browser_type matches "*Mobile/*" OR browser_type matches "*AppleWebKit*(KHTML*Gecko)*"),"Mobile Safari",Browser) as Browser
| if (browser == "" AND OS=="MacOS" AND browser_type matches "Mozilla/* (Macintosh;*(KHTML, like Gecko)*","Safari",Browser) as Browser
| if (browser_type matches "*MobileSafari/*","Mobile Safari",Browser) as Browser
| if (browser_type matches "*Chrome*","Chrome",Browser) as Browser
| if (browser_type matches "Opera*","Opera",Browser) as Browser
| if (browser_type matches "Dolphin*","Dolphin",Browser) as Browser
| if (Browser == "","Other",Browser) as Browser
| count by browser | sort by _count desc
